tenderSchedule.title: Providing Human resource service (Graduate Engineers and Diploma Engineers) for carrying out DAS operations at both BESCOM Integrated Control Centres (BICC-1, HSR Layout & BICC-2 Rajajinagar)2027-2029
tenderSchedule.description: The Agency shall provide 29 nos of project Engineers(Graduate Engineers)& 66 nos of Project Technical Assistants(Diploma Engineers)to work in DAS CCR shifts across 24X7 as per specification -works related to SCADA/DMS/OMS/INMS planning activities in DAS & operating the automation system.
tenderSchedule.locationName: BESCOM Corporate Office DAS section Bengaluru

tenderAddress.blockNumber: The General Manager (DAS), BESCOM Integrated Control Center-1, 17th cross, 24th Main, Sector-2, HSR layout, Bangalore-560102

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Bidder should have EPF, ESI, Labour, GST and Workmen compensation act registration with respective State/Central Government authorities and proof of such registration certificates should be uploaded along with the bid.a)EPF Registration certificate with Number and date.b)ESI Registration Number with date.c)Bidders PAN Card.d)GSTN registration certificate with Number and date.Valid labor license issued by labour department duly indicating the period of validity.Document to be upload- Bidder should upload in the eProcurement portal a copy of valid EPF Registration certificate, ESI registration number, PAN card, GSTN registration certificate, Valid labour license.

Even though the Bidders meet the above criteria, they are subject to be disqualified if they have a) Made misleading or false representations in the forms, statements and attachments submitted in proof of the qualification requirements and/or b) Record of poor performance such as abandoning the services, not properly completing the contract, inordinate delays in completion, litigation history, or financial failures etc. and/or c) Participated in the previous Tender for the same work and had quoted unreasonably high tender prices and could not furnish rational justification and/or d)Black-Listed due to non-performance in execution of works by any central/state govt undertaking utility/ Govt Dept as on date of bid submission. e) Defaulted/short closed due to non-performance in execution of works against the order placed by any central/state govt undertaking electrical utility/ Govt Dept as on date of bid submission.Documnets to be upload-Scanned copy of Self-Declaration Notarized stamp paper of Rs. 500/- as per the format in the bid document shall be uploaded.Self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done

Any Bidder from a country which shares a land with India will be eligible to bid in this tender only if the Tenderer is registered with the Competent Authority. (As per Government Order no: FD 455 Exp-12/2020 dt: 25.08.2020).A certificate for having read the clauses is required to be submitted/uploaded by the bidder separately in the following format:I have read the clause regarding restrictions on procurement from a Bidder of a country which shares a land border with India .I certify that this Bidder is not from such a country or, if from such a country, has been registered with the Competent Authority. I hereby certify that this Bidder fulfills all requirements in this regard and is eligible to be considered.(Where applicable, evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority shall be attached).Documents to be upload-Scanned copy of Self-Declaration Notarized stamp paper of Rs. 500/- as per the format in the bid document shall be uploaded.If the Bidder from a country which shares a land with India, Registration certificate issued by the competent authority shall be uploaded.Self-declaration shall clearly indicate the tender enquiry number and date on which declaration is done

Litigation History-The Bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years i.e.FY 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 , 2024-25 2025-26 A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Bidder may result in rejection of Bid.Documnets to be uploaded-Self-declaration on notarized stamp paper of Rs. 500/- shall be uploaded

The bidder should furnish a self-declaration stating that the information/data furnished as part of their bid is true and correct. Subsequently, if it is found incorrect, such bidder will be black listed and further action will be initiated.Documnets to be uploded-Self-declaration should be uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should poses liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than 25% of amount put to tender (Credit lines/ letter of credit/ certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. (usually the equivalent of the estimated cash flow for three months in the peak construction period).The cash at bank and bank deposits as on 30.09.2026 or at later date before last date of submission of technical bid should be supported by certificate issued by any scheduled/nationalized bank duly indicating the balance on given date.(The bidder is having bank account in multiple banks. The cash at bank, bank deposit and fund based credit facility for the bidder it should be on the same date for all the banks).In case of Fund based credit facility, the certificate issued by the scheduled/nationalized bank duly mentioning the sanctioned limits, funds.Documents to be uploaded-The cash at bank, bank deposits & fund based credit facilities as on 30.09.2026 or at later date before last date of bid submission should be supported by certificate issued by any scheduled/ nationalized bank duly indicating the sanctioned, utilized and balance amount on a given date.(In case the bidder is having multiple bank accounts. The document issued by banks supporting cash at bank, bank deposits and fund based credit facility for the bidder should be on the same date for all banks accounts).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tender Capacity-The Bidder who meets the above specified minimum qualifying criteria, will only be qualified, if their available tender capacity is more than the Amount Put to tender.The available tender capacity will be calculated as under-Assessed available tender (A*N*1.5-B) capacity.A is equal to Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to FY 2026-27 in which tenders are invited), taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N is equal to Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited.B is equal to Value, at FY in which tenders are invited price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 2 years.The information regarding Qualifying requirement has to be filled by the Tenderer in the prescribed format mentioned under section 3 Qualification Information of KW4.Documents to be uploaded- Scanned copy of the statements showing the Total value executed & payment received (excluding GST) in the last five years (FY-2021-22 to FY 2025-26) and UDI number of the bidder duly certified by the Chartered Accountant shall be uploaded.Scanned copy of the statements showing the value of existing commitments & on-going works (Excluding GST) as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works as per the format prescribed in the bid documents certified by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Executive Engineer or equivalent shall be uploaded.The bidder note that the value of pendency of work (Excluding GST) shall be considered based on financial progress achieved in the particular work as on the date of bid submission
